examples.label: Search row with a submit button
examples.source:
<.component component_name="chelekom-input" site="Global" id="docs-search-query" name="q" value="" type="search" label="Search the documentation" />
<.component component_name="chelekom-input-button" site="Global" id="docs-search-submit" type="submit" value="Search" variant="default" color="primary" size="small" />

examples.label: Form action row with save and reset
examples.source:
<.component component_name="chelekom-input" site="Global" id="profile-display-name" name="display_name" value="Sara Mehrabi" type="text" label="Display name" /> <.component component_name="chelekom-input" site="Global" id="profile-title" name="title" value="Product designer" type="text" label="Job title" /> <.component component_name="chelekom-hr" site="Global" margin="small" />
<.component component_name="chelekom-input-button" site="Global" id="profile-reset" type="reset" value="Discard" variant="outline" color="natural" size="medium" /> <.component component_name="chelekom-input-button" site="Global" id="profile-save" type="submit" value="Save changes" variant="default" color="primary" size="medium" />
